style: Say brightly and cheerfully, like an upbeat first grade teacher
lines: Tap a piece of the poster to open its source. Tap a slot on the card, then tap the fact on the source.
Books hide facts on more than one page. Tap the arrows to turn the pages.
Every piece has a card. Press Test my credits.
Found it! A thank-you is on its way.
Stuck! Press Back to my cards, then fix that card.
All three found! Every creator got a thank-you.
These are the creators. Tap a mailbox to see their story and your thank-you notes.
With no name, nobody knows who to thank. Flip the switch back to give the credit back.
